parsed.answer: Your report (Settings won't open in v0.100.2) matches earlier tickets where the Settings window does nothing when launched from the tray icon or Start menu. In PowerToys#18209, a maintainer marked it a duplicate of #18015 and said the cause may be incompatibility with GPU or PC-statistics/monitoring software, or the computer running everything elevated. Try closing or disabling any such software and not running everything as administrator. Reinstalling did not help in those tickets. Users there got Settings working again by rolling back to the previous PowerToys version until a fix was released, so you can install an earlier release. In #15315, restarting the machine was suggested, but that ticket never found a cause or fix. If none of this works, please attach a PowerToys bug report ZIP (from the PowerToys Bug Report Tool) and describe exactly what happens, because your ticket has no actual-behavior details.
